title: 库奇·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 白色大胡须衬着飞行帽与护目镜，保留约德尔飞行员的紧凑体态。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Corki is a small adult yordle pilot with an enormous white moustache, aviator cap, large goggles, compact furry face, and fully covering flight jacket, gloves, trousers, and boots. Preserve his distinctive rounded aircraft with visible wings, propeller, and brass fittings. The aircraft is firmly parked and all propellers and mounted equipment remain motionless, without firing, flight trails, or combat imagery.
art_direction.scene: A broad full-body study, weight settled naturally on the feet or canonical support, expansive silhouette and an economical pale environment cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: mustard yellow, leather brown, steel blue, sunrise ivory; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
